note: Final session cost $12.07 exceeds the $8 plan-stated hard cap by $4.07. The overrun was driven by ~7 hours of idle compute when the initial implementation subagent went silent before launching the NSGA-II run, plus the additional $0.4568 over the $4 per-seed cap from the watchdog completing the in-progress generation before exiting, plus ~39 min of post-watchdog uptime until teardown. The cost watchdog itself behaved as designed (tripped at $4.00 for both seeds), but the per-seed expense was higher than projected because N_EVAL_SEEDS=4 took longer per cell on the EPYC 7B13 + Spain machine ($0.4852/hr) than the plan's $0.24/hr Norway target estimate. The user authorised the overrun in advance.
